source.title: On Some Open Problems Related to X-Permutability of Subgroups

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 5918862. A local shard row for this identifier records DOI 10.1080/00927871003592007 and year 2011.

Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged or unreadable HTML for the exact zbMATH resolver URL; network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches of api.zbmath.org; and metadata_only or paywalled_or_restricted for the DOI landing page. DOI metadata and search results identify the exact work as Baojun Li and Wenbin Guo, "On Some Open Problems Related to X-Permutability of Subgroups," Communications in Algebra 39(3), 757-771, DOI 10.1080/00927871003592007. The available Taylor & Francis result exposed the abstract, citation metadata, and table-of-contents links, but no readable article body or PDF could be fetched in the available tools.

Ran exact-work recovery searches for the DOI, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus page range, the DOI plus PDF/full text, and distinctive phrases from the DOI metadata. Candidate pages inspected or surfaced by search were rejected because they were abstract-only Taylor & Francis pages, tables of contents, references in later articles, correction articles for a different work, or related works on permutability rather than the same full article. No candidate was confirmed as a readable full-text artifact for the same DOI or exact title.

trace.notes: No document map, candidate extraction, rewrite, or dedupe stages were run because no readable primary source artifact was recovered. The source adequacy gate rejected extracting open questions from DOI metadata, abstracts, table-of-contents snippets, references, search snippets, or different works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5918862.json and outputs/latest.json.
